Subject: Request for interim coverage statement for SOC 2 Type II (post-report gap)

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from our audit/compliance team. We have Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report that covers the period ending 2026-12-31 (SOC2_Redwood_20261231.pdf). Our external auditors need an interim management assertion (commonly called a bridge letter) that confirms there have been no material changes to the control environment for the period from 2027-01-01 through the date of the letter (we’re currently tracking to 2027-05-03).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a signed bridge/continuity letter covering that post-report gap? If yes, we need:
- A management assertion that control environment and scope remain materially unchanged,
- Any exceptions or changes since 2026-12-31, and whether compensating controls were implemented,
- Name and contact for your audit liaison (for our auditors to validate).

Our timeline is tight — auditors asked if we could get something executed within two business days if possible. Let me know what you can provide and if you prefer a template.

Thanks,
Alex
